text: Saalihu jaabii yimɓe makko ɓen o maaki: Ko onon yo yimɓe! Yeetee lam si mi woni e hujja ɓannguɗo ɓannguɗo immorde ka Joomi am, O okkii lam yur- meende Annabaaku immorde ka Makko, ko hombo daɗndata lam e lepte Makko ɗen si tawii mi yeddirii Mo ronnkude yottingol ko O Nuli lam kon e mon? On ɓeydatah lam si wanah majjere e woɗɗitagol welu Makko.
